description: Keeps the pinned versions current: the Python packages in every requirements file (requirements.txt, requirements-dev.txt, requirements-optional.txt and experiments/requirements.txt) and the actions in .github/workflows. Renovate opens a pull request for each update and a person merges it; nothing merges by itself. A release must be three days old before it is offered, because a broken or compromised release is usually withdrawn within days. Updates are looked for once a week; security updates open at once. Not covered: the model files experiments/clip_local.py downloads. They are fixed to one revision and checked by SHA-256, and a different revision changes the measured results, so they are changed by hand together with a new measurement.

packageRules.description: One pull request for all the actions, since they change together and CI checks them the same way.
